legacy_failure_addressed: legacy paper-side recording had no typed mirror of risk decisions, no paper_trade_id lineage, and no machine-checked invariant that paper actions never escape into a live order path. Without a typed value-object surface, downstream replay/backtest analysis cannot tie a paper outcome back to the originating risk decision and prediction, and a paper-side recorder could silently omit the live-blocked flag. The 2H.A value-object pins the mirror taxonomy at the type level (record_allow MUST be paired with mirror_allow_*; record_deny MUST be paired with mirror_deny_*; every mirror reason maps one-to-one to an upstream risk reason), introduces the paper_trade_id lineage ID, and enforces live_blocked == True at construction time. This unblocks REQ_0017 milestones 5/6/7 with a non-ambiguous lineage chain.

It is the value-object layer of the paper-side mirror surface preceded by 2G.A/B/C risk-gateway default-deny milestones.
